query: Let `M` be an `R`-module, `n : ℕ`, and `v : I → M` an indexed family with `I` linearly ordered. If the range of `v` spans `M`, then the family `(v(i₁) ∧ ⋯ ∧ v(iₙ))` indexed by ordered subsets `{i₁ < ⋯ < iₙ} ⊆ I` of size `n` spans the `n`th exterior power `⋀ⁿ M ⊆ ⋀M` (viewed as a submodule of the exterior algebra).

   335  the span of `n`-fold _ordered_ wedge products of elements of the `v i`. -/
   336  private lemma ιMulti_family_span_fixedDegree_aux
   337      {I : Type*} [LinearOrder I] (v : I → M) (α : Fin n → I) :
   338      ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n (v ∘ α) ∈ span R (range (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_family R n v)) := by
   339    by_cases α_inj : Injective α; swap

   341      exact AlternatingMap.map_eq_zero_of_not_injective _ _ <| fun h ↦ α_inj (Injective.of_comp h)
   342    suffices ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n ((v ∘ α) ∘ σ)) ∈
   343        Submodule.span R (Set.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_family R n v)) by
   344      obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := this

   346      refine (Submodule.smul_mem_iff_of_isUnit _ (r := (σ.sign : R)) ?_).mp hσ
   347      rw [isUnit_iff_exists_inv]
   348      use (σ.sign : R)
   349      norm_cast

   351    have α_card : (Finset.image α Finset.univ).card = n :=

   353    use (Finset.orderIsoOfFin (Finset.image α Finset.univ) α_card).toEquiv.trans
